definitions.gloss: to be based on, to be grounded on
definitions.explanation: To have something as a foundation or basis.

examples.japanese: {事実|じじつ}に{基|もと}づく{話|はなし}
{法律|ほうりつ}に{基|もと}づいて{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: To judge based on the law.

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}に{基|もと}づいて{判断|はんだん}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to make judgments based on experience.

notes:
{基|もと}づく means to be based on or grounded in something. Always takes the particle に.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (the basis takes に particle).

CONJUGATION (godan く-verb):
- {基|もと}づかない (negative)
- {基|もと}づきます (polite)
- {基|もと}づいた (past)
- {基|もと}づいて (te-form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{基|もと}づく: based on ~
- 〜に{基|もと}づいて: based on ~ (te-form, adverbial)
- 〜に{基|もと}づいた: based on ~ (attributive)
- {事実|じじつ}に{基|もと}づく: based on facts
- {法律|ほうりつ}に{基|もと}づいて: based on the law
- {経験|けいけん}に{基|もと}づく: based on experience

WORD FORMATION:
{基|もと} (base, foundation) + づく (to attach to)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜を{元|もと}にする: to use ~ as a basis (more flexible)
- 〜を{踏|ふ}まえる: to take ~ into consideration
- 〜に{則|のっと}る: to follow, conform to (more formal)
